android.desc:
Valuta+: The Best Currency Converter App for Travel & Finance

Make checking exchange rates simple and fast with Valuta+. Newly redesigned for Android, our app is more beautiful and easier to use than ever. Whether you are traveling the world, shopping online, or comparing prices, Valuta+ is the perfect calculator for your daily currency needs.

What makes Valuta+ extra special? You can view multiple converted currencies all at the exact same time! There is no need to switch back and forth. You can see how much an item costs in USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and more, all on one single screen.

Supporting over 170 global currencies, Valuta+ helps you stay on top of the latest foreign exchange rates instantly.

TOP FEATURES
• Fresh Android Design: A sleek, modern look that makes calculating rates a breeze.
• Dark Mode: Easy on the eyes day or night with full dark mode support.
• New Settings Screen: Pick your base currency and toggle currency flags on or off.
• Country Flags: Easily spot your favorite currencies with beautiful country flags for a clear overview.
• Set Your Base Currency: Choose your main currency to make daily comparisons even faster.
• Compare All At Once: Type in one amount and instantly see it calculated across your own list of currencies.
• Reorder & Delete: Drag to reorder your currency list and swipe to delete the ones you don’t need.
• 170+ Global Currencies: Look up rates for US Dollars, Euros, British Pounds, and more.
• Offline Mode: Traveling without internet? No problem. Valuta+ works perfectly offline using your last saved rates.
• Real time Accuracy: Automatic rate updates based on trusted market data.
• Custom Rate Adjustments: Add custom fees to your calculations to see what your bank or ATM might actually charge you.
• Smoother Experience: Behind-the-scenes fixes keep everything running smoothly.

PERFECT FOR TRAVELERS
Say goodbye to complicated math at the airport or local markets. Whether you need a US currency converter for a trip to New York, or you are calculating pesos to dollars, Valuta+ provides instant and reliable currency conversions.

"Perfect for my travels! It is so easy to see multiple currency rates at the same time!" - Google Play Review

Why choose Valuta+? Because we believe helpful tools should be easy to use. Download Valuta+ today and carry the best global exchange rate calculator right in your pocket.
